explanation: Ganesha is honoured as the remover of obstacles, so many Hindus pray to him before starting something new. He is often shown riding a mouse.

claims.text: Ganesha is the Hindu god usually depicted with an elephant's head.

Ganesha is revered as the remover of obstacles and is invoked at the start of new undertakings.
Ganesha's mount (vahana) is usually a mouse or rat.
